name: Nabtesco Corporation
summary: Nabtesco Corporation manufactures and sells industrial robot parts, construction machinery, railway vehicle brake systems, and automatic doors, aircraft parts, automobile brakes and drive controls, marine, and platform safety products in Japan and internationally. It offers precision reduction gear for component and gear head types; hydraulic equipment, such as traveling units for crawlers, control valves for mini excavators, and swing units for hydraulic excavators; railroad vehicle equipment, such as unit brakes, door operators, and brake operating units; and aircraft equipment comprising flight control actuation systems and high-voltage electric power distribution units.
